proposals.title: Draft several stories rather than one story with many steps
proposals.prompt:
Drafting, whether from Draft stories, Ask agent, or Draft with agent, prefers
several stories to one story with many steps. Each separate piece of work,
anything someone would send and check off on its own, becomes a story of its
own, a "New story" proposal, as spec/scope/planning/index.pi#Planning.drafting
and spec/scope/planning/index.pi#Planning.draftingWithAgent describe the split.
Steps, as spec/scope/planning/index.pi#Planning.steps defines them, are kept
for pieces that only make sense after the one before, within one piece of work.

New behaviour is proposed as a single Chain story by default, one prompt that
runs the usual spec step and then the code step, plus a spec follow-up when
the chain asks for one, as spec/scope/prompt-mode/index.pi#PromptEditor.chainedTasks
says and spec/scope/prompt-mode/modes/index.pi#PromptModes.modes describes Chain.
The drafter never splits that into a Spec step and a Code step of its own, or
adds a step only to update the spec after the code: Chain already does both.

Change the Planning spec's drafting sections to say this, and the planning
prompt, planning.pi, listed in
spec/scope/harness-integration/baked-prompts/index.pi#BakedSystemPrompts.prompts,
so that it asks for it. Its guidance and its examples should show a request
becoming several Chain stories, with steps only where one piece truly follows
another, and stop asking for "the steps it needs" as though every story needs
some.

proposals.title: List every step of a story, its prompt as step 1
proposals.prompt:
Wherever a story's steps are listed, every step is listed, the story's own
prompt among them as step 1, never the prompt on its own with "the rest"
beneath it. As spec/scope/planning/index.pi#Planning.steps and
spec/scope/planning/index.pi#Planning.stories say today, the open story shows
its prompt apart and numbers its steps from 2. The card's step count says
"3 steps", but its tooltip, and the step lines in Current sprint and Done, list
only the steps after the prompt.

Once this is done:
- The open story lists all of its steps as one numbered list, 1 to N. Step 1
  is the story's prompt, edited in place as it is now, and it still can't be
  moved or removed.
- A card's tooltip lists every step, 1 to N, so it matches its count.
- In Current sprint and Done, and in a finding started from the story, the
  step lines start with step 1, the prompt, each with its own status.

The count and every list agree everywhere, as the spec already requires.
Change spec/scope/planning/index.pi#Planning.steps and
spec/scope/planning/index.pi#Planning.stories to say so, then the code to
match.

spec.quote: each a row numbered from 2, the story's own prompt being 1
